title: ProjectBinding
description: Defines local project repository binding and delivery backend configuration.

project_root.description: Absolute filesystem root path of the project.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the project or product.

delivery_backend_kind.description: Type of external ALM delivery backend.

delivery_binding_ref.description: Key or reference to specific backend credentials/configuration.

is_governed.description: Whether this project enforces strict gate and SoD compliance.

organization_url.description: Base HTTPS URL of the Azure DevOps organization.

team_project.description: Azure DevOps Team Project container name.

iteration_path.description: Current sprint or release iteration path.

assigned_team.description: Target team name owning the backlog.

repository_name.description: Optional Azure Repos Git repository name.

service_hook_secret_ref.description: Vault or environment reference for Webhook HMAC validation (SEC-R1-01).
